answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a real-world credential without revealing it: the agent proves in zero knowledge that it holds a unique government-issued document, and the proof commits to a hidden nullifier, so one document mints exactly one identity. A forger growing a timber forest of clones would need a separate real passport for each one, and buying stolen documents is costly and traceable, while honest agents keep their privacy intact, no fable of anonymity is broken, and the reef of fake identities founders on the price of real-world credentials.
